resources.string: Enter your Google OAuth client ID first (Settings → Gmail sign-in).
Install a web browser to sign in with Google.
The saved sign-in data is not available. Sign in again.
The sign-in took too long. Try again.
You did not give access in the browser. Try again, or use an app password.
Google sign-in failed (%1$s). Try again, or use an app password.
Plico did not get access to Gmail. Sign in again and allow access to Gmail.
The answer from Google was not complete. Try again.
Google stopped the access of Plico to this account. Sign in again.
Google does not accept your OAuth client ID. Make sure that it is an Android client for the package name and signing SHA-1 of this app.
Google does not know this app. In your Google Cloud project, add an Android OAuth client for the package name and signing SHA-1 of this app. Or use an app password.
Google must get your permission again. Sign in again.
Plico cannot use the Google account on this phone. Choose the account again, or use an app password.
Gmail does not show All Mail to IMAP. In Gmail on the web, go to Settings → Labels and turn on \"Show in IMAP\" for All Mail.
Gmail does not show Trash to IMAP, so Delete is off. To turn it on, go to Gmail Settings → Labels and turn on \"Show in IMAP\" for Trash.
Gmail does not show Spam to IMAP, so Spam is off. To turn it on, go to Gmail Settings → Labels and turn on \"Show in IMAP\" for Spam.
